intro: Torn between Kanchanaburi and Khao Yai? Here is an honest, side-by-side comparison so you can pick the one that fits your trip — or fit both in.

blocks.html: Short answer: Both are popular nature escapes near Bangkok. Choose Kanchanaburi (west, ~2–3h) for the River Kwai, wartime history, Erawan Falls and riverside raft stays. Choose Khao Yai (lower northeast, ~2.5h) for the wildlife national park, wineries, scenic cafés and luxury resorts.

blocks.text: Kanchanaburi vs Khao Yai at a glance

items: Pick Kanchanaburi if you want the River Kwai, history, Erawan Falls and riverside raft stays
Pick Khao Yai if you want a wildlife park, wineries, scenic cafés and luxury resorts
Both are close to Bangkok — great weekend escapes; choose history-and-river or forest-and-wine

faq.q: Kanchanaburi or Khao Yai — which is better?
faq.a: Kanchanaburi stands out for the River Kwai, wartime history and waterfalls — great for adventure and families. Khao Yai is known for its wildlife park, wineries and upscale cafés and resorts — ideal for road trips and couples.
Both work for families — Kanchanaburi has Erawan Falls for swimming and the exciting Death Railway, while Khao Yai has wildlife spotting, sheep farms and farm cafés that kids love.

faq.q: Without a car, which is easier?
faq.a: Kanchanaburi is a bit easier without a car thanks to trains and in-town tours, whereas Khao Yai is very spread out with little public transport, so you almost need a car or a hired car with driver.
